run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the first element occurring k times in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold with arrays and k values to verify correct element frequency detection
review_f_gold: review f_gold which uses a count map to track element frequencies in an array
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use collections.Counter instead of a manual dictionary for counting
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which returns the first array element that appears exactly k times
